t: What Quantum Key Distribution Networks (QKD) Is
title: What Quantum Key Distribution Networks (QKD) Is
provenance: Public research knowledge: documented developments, published research, and established technical references. Real, fact-checked records.
description: Quantum key distribution networks share encryption keys using quantum physics: keys are encoded in single photons, and any eavesdropping disturbs the quantum states and reveals itself. The result is key exchange with security guaranteed by physics, not by hard math problems. This record is the entry point of the teaching ladder for Quantum Key Distribution Networks (QKD): start here, then move through the research state, the specifications, the public developments, the open challenges, and finally each piece needed to build it.
key_points: Quantum Key Distribution Networks (QKD) in one line: Quantum key distribution networks share encryption keys using quantum physics: keys are encoded in single photons, and any eavesdropping disturbs the quantum states and reveals itself.
Why it matters: It offers future-proof key exchange — secure even against quantum computers — for the most sensitive links..
Where it is used: government backbones, financial networks, critical infrastructure, diplomatic communications..
Ladder rank 1 — the foundation. Everything else builds on this.

t: Current Research State of Quantum Key Distribution Networks (QKD)
title: Current Research State of Quantum Key Distribution Networks (QKD)
provenance: Public research knowledge: documented developments, published research, and established technical references. Real, fact-checked records.
description: QKD networks operate in China (Beijing-Shanghai backbone), Europe (EuroQCI), and via satellite (Micius); trusted-node networks span thousands of kilometers. Research targets measurement-device-independent QKD, higher key rates, and ultimately quantum repeaters for repeater-based security. The gap: trusted nodes are a security compromise, and key rates are low. Research moves in three waves: laboratory proof of concept, scaled prototypes under controlled conditions, and field trials. Quantum Key Distribution Networks (QKD) currently sits at the stage described above, and the pieces records show what each wave still needs.

provenance: Public research knowledge: documented developments, published research, and established technical references. Real, fact-checked records.
description: WDM multiplexing quantum and classical signals on one fiber, avoiding dark-fiber costs. In the Quantum Key Distribution Networks (QKD) system this piece plays the economics role: it shares fiber with normal traffic Maturity: deployed.
key_points: Coexistence Multiplexer: WDM multiplexing quantum and classical signals on one fiber, avoiding dark-fiber costs.
Role: Economics — it shares fiber with normal traffic.
how_it_works: Mount the Coexistence Multiplexer into the Quantum Key Distribution Networks (QKD) assembly at its designed interface point.
Connect power, data, and control lines per the interface specification.
Run the bring-up self-test and confirm nominal telemetry.
Calibrate the Coexistence Multiplexer against its reference standard before full operation.
requirements: Interface specification for the Coexistence Multiplexer
Power and signal conditioning to spec
standards: Burn-in / life test on a sample lot
Traceability of every unit to its lot
safety: Lock out the system before mechanical work
troubleshooting: No output: check power rails and enable lines first
Intermittent faults: reseat connectors and check grounding
Overheating: verify thermal path and load current
Out-of-spec readings: re-run calibration, then swap with a known-good unit
citations: Documented public research on Quantum Key Distribution Networks (QKD): peer-reviewed literature, technical standards, industry announcements, and open technical documentation.
